questions.q: What is the script of the Punjabi language?
questions.exp: Punjabi is written in the Gurmukhi script.

questions.q: How many original letters were there in the Gurmukhi alphabet?
questions.exp: The alphabet originally consisted of 35 letters, earning it the name 'Painti Akhri'.

questions.q: How many letters are there in the modern Gurmukhi alphabet?
questions.exp: Six more letters were added by placing a dot (bindi) at the foot, bringing the total to 41.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a vowel bearer (Swar) in Gurmukhi?
questions.exp: There are only three vowel bearers: ੳ, ਅ, and ੲ. 'ਸ' is a consonant.

questions.q: How many vowel bearers (Swar Uchar) are there in Gurmukhi?
questions.exp: There are three primary vowel bearers: Oora, Aira, and Eeri.

questions.q: How many vowel symbols (lagaan) are there?
Which of these letters was added to accommodate Persian sounds?
questions.exp: ਸ਼ is one of the six letters added with a bindi at the foot.

questions.q: What does the word 'Gurmukhi' literally mean?
opts: From the mouth of the Guru
questions.exp: Gurmukhi translates to 'from the mouth of the Guru'.
